name: Product Structure 1 Code
definition: Specifies the structure of a financial instrument.

NUMM.name: Non UCITS Money Market Fund
NUMM.definition: Product is a money market fund that is not an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS).

UCMM.name: UCITS Money Market Fund
UCMM.definition: Product is an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) money market fund.

EXTC.name: Exchange Traded Commodity
EXTC.definition: Product is an exchange traded commodity.

UCIT.name: UCITS
UCIT.definition: Product is an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS).

NUCI.name: Non UCITS
NUCI.definition: Product is a not an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS).
